task_description: Fix Taskly's broken functionality end to end for session-based/local usage: unify authentication (session-cookie frontend vs Bearer-only backend routes), persist profile/settings updates, repair the onboarding flow (persist to user.onboarding, fix fullname mapping, resolve empty step 4, add user + view previous onboards), set up Cloudinary image upload and the email service, reconcile frontend service calls against real backend routes, wire the existing Teams/Projects UI to the backend, repair the stale backend test suite and add a backend ESLint config, and fix CI/CD. Scope is fixes to existing functionality, not new complex features. No secrets hardcoded; no Terraform apply.
